jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II - West
jobs.description:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote position that must be based in PST or MST.

The  Customer Success Manager role will play a critical part in the exciting growth trajectory of Tines. As an automation platform, the more the customer automates, the more value they see. Your role will be to drive adoption and expand the usage across the customer base, ensuring that our customers realize the full potential of the platform. Alongside expansion with existing teams, you will play a crucial part in our strategy to expand outside of security teams into other functions in our clients (IT, Engineering, Operations).

You will do this by supporting our customers from onboarding to ongoing support to expansion and renewals. You will become a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on the Tines product, helping foster champions within the customer who will identify automation opportunities across their organization. At the same time, you will provide feedback to our Product and Engineering teams, helping us shape the future of the product. The role will also partner closely with Sales, Support, Marketing, and other internal teams.

What you will be doing:

- Leading a first-class onboarding experience and ensuring customer use cases and requirements are met in the specified timeline

- Translating technical customer needs to internal technical teams and delivering feedback to the Product team on new feature requests and enhancements to shape and improve the platform

- Coordinating onboarding and business reviews to evaluate performance, learn about the customers priorities, and locate new opportunities to promote expansion within existing and new teams

- Partnering with internal resources to build account plans and align customer needs with use cases to increase platform usage

- Proactively identify risks to the customer achieving their stated goals, and work with the CSM / PM teams to develop and drive a comprehensive risk mitigation plan

- Identifying issues that impact customers and/or challenges in the business and are able to provide thought leadership in finding a customer solution or assist in co-development of process improvement, programs and/or assets

- Developing and driving a renewal plan and delivering a strategic message to analysts, management, and the C-Suite on the value of Tines and next steps for the account

- Review account dashboards, metrics, log-ins, and use cases to determine the health of the customer

What you bring with you:

- 3+ years of experience in a technical account management, customer success, or post-sales role at a technology company

- Experience with a SaaS solutions offering for technical teams (cybersecurity, DevOps, IT, other)

- Experience asking questions to uncover problems, locate new opportunities, and translate technical requirements to internal teams and partners

- Knowledge of API's + how they function

Target Annual Earnings (salary + commission): $125K OTE (80/20 split)

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Field Marketing Manager to join our marketing team. This role will play a pivotal role in orchestrating our event marketing efforts as well as some account based marketing across the West regions which includes curating branded experiences, partner events, and regional industry events. This role requires a creative thinker with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What you will be doing:

- Event Program Management: Plan, execute, and manage a portfolio of regional events, including hospitality experiences, partner events, and industry-specific gatherings. Ensure each event aligns with Tines' brand values and marketing objectives.

- Event Coordination and Execution: Oversee all aspects of event planning and execution, including registration, shipping, setup, day-of event support and post-event wrap-up.

- Tradeshow and Tentpole Support: Provide support for larger-scale tradeshows and tentpole events. This includes coordination with vendors, managing logistics, and ensuring brand consistency.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with GTM and marketing teams to ensure event messaging and goals are aligned with broader company objectives.

- Budget Management: Oversee and manage the budget for regional events, ensuring cost-effective strategies without compromising event quality.

- Reporting and Analysis: Work with Marketing Ops to track event attendance, manage list uploads and evaluate the success of each event based on predetermined KPIs and metrics. Provide post-event reports and insights.

- SWAG Management : Oversee inventory, coordinate distribution at events, and ensure the quality and relevance of SWAG to enhance brand recognition and customer engagement.

What you bring with you:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field

- Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, with a specific focus on field marketing and events. Prior experience managing both small-scale and large-scale events is required.

- Skills: Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Strong communication and negotiation skills are essential.

- Creative thinker with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Teamwork: Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment, collaborating with other departments to achieve marketing goals.

- Adaptability: Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage high-pressure situations effectively.

- Passion for Event Marketing: A strong interest in curating unforgettable experiences, with a keen eye for detail and a creative mindset.

- Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote position that must be based in PST or MST.

Role Overview

As a Lead Customer Success Manager , you will own the post-sales strategic relationship, retention, and value realization across our highest-stakes enterprise accounts. You are a self-starter and bar-raiser who operates with high autonomy, driving customer outcomes while working in tight partnership with Sales to uncover and capitalize on strategic growth opportunities.

In this role, you will serve as the trusted advisor and strategic lead for your portfolio, orchestrating technical and commercial counterparts—including Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), Account Executives, and Product leaders. You will bridge complex technical deployments with executive-level business goals, ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investment and naturally expand their footprint with us.

Key Responsibilities

- Drive Strategic Account Value & Retention: Accountable for net retention, customer health, and long-term strategic alignment across a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts.

- Partner with Sales for Account Growth: Work side-by-side with Account Executives/Strategic Account Managers to identify expansion vectors, co-develop account plans, and position new capabilities that directly support the customer's technical roadmap.

- Integrate with Technical Counterparts: Partner closely with Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and technical leads to ensure technical delivery aligns directly with the client's business outcomes, removing friction and accelerating time-to-value.

- Operate as an Independent Bar-Raiser: Proactively build scalable Customer Success playbooks, elevate executive engagement standards, and operate with extreme ownership without needing step-by-step guidance.

- Cultivate C-Suite & Technical Sponsorship: Build multi-threaded relationships across business and technology functions (CIO, CISO, CTO, VPs of Engineering, Product Leads) to ensure continuous alignment with top corporate initiatives.

- Drive Business Outcomes & QBRs: Shift client conversations from product usage to business impact, leading executive business reviews (EBRs/QBRs) that demonstrate clear ROI and anchor the account for long-term growth.

Qualifications & Requirements

- Post-Sales Strategic Track Record: 10+ years in Enterprise Customer Success, Account Management, or Technical Account Management handling high-ARR, complex enterprise platforms.

- Commercial Acumen & Growth Mindset: Proven history of partnering with Sales to identify, nurture, and help close upsells, expansions, and renewals in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

- Technical & FDE Alignment: Deep experience collaborating with Forward-Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, and product delivery teams to translate technical achievements into commercial value.

- High Autonomy & Leadership: Self-motivated bar-raiser with a bias for action who excels in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and takes full accountability for account outcomes.

- Executive Presence: Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with a track record of challenging and advising C-level executives on technology strategy and operational efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves / Pluses

- High Tech Industry Expertise: Domain knowledge in High Tech (e.g., cloud native, hardware/software OEMs, or AI/ML platforms) and an understanding of how engineering-led enterprises operate and scale.

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

- Month 3: Fully onboarded, account health assessments completed, and tight alignment established with assigned Sales AEs and FDE teams on key accounts.

- Month 6: Value-realization frameworks and executive cadence active across all accounts, with clear expansion pipelines co-developed alongside Sales.

- Month 12: High Net Retention Rate (NRR) achieved across the portfolio, demonstrable business outcomes delivered with FDEs, and elevated CS playbooks established as standard practice for the broader team.

Target Annual Earnings (salary + commission): $190K-220K OTE (80/20 split)

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Compensation
jobs.description:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

We're looking for a sales compensation leader to own how we pay our go-to-market organisation, and how that changes as our commercial model changes. You will run the engine that pays roughly 350 GTM people accurately and on time, own the design of the plans, quotas and incentives behind it, and lead a small team of analysts.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage and coach a small team, and you will also be in the model, in CaptivateIQ, and in the plan documents yourself.

What you'll do

Run the compensation engine

- Own the monthly and quarterly compensation cycle end to end: crediting, calculation, review, approval and payout, delivered accurately and on time

- Own CaptivateIQ as our system of record for incentive compensation, including plan build, rule logic, testing and release

- Own crediting and comp data integrity across Salesforce and downstream systems, and work with Systems and Deal Desk to fix problems at source rather than in spreadsheets

- Oversee inquiry management ensuring clear SLAs and report on trends to improve overall processes

- Document and keep policies and process up to date for stakeholders and your team

Design the plans, quotas and incentives

- Own annual plan design in partnership with your Senior compensation analyst, GTM leadership, FP&A and People for all commissioned roles

- Collaborate with Revops business partners on the quota setting process for each function to ensure it aligns with broader compensation strategy and benchmarks

- Model attainment distribution, benchmarks and support finance in ad-hoc cost reporting

- Own and build SPIFFs and non-cash incentive programmes, including President's Club,

- Own plan communication and enablement, so reps and managers understand what they are paid for and can self-serve where needed

Evolve the compensation strategy as we grow

- Build the compensation approach for an evolving pricing model and mulit-product business in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and VP of Finance

- Represent compensation requirements during larger CPQ and CRM enhancements or changes

- Enhance our approach based compensation reporting: attainment by role and segment, payout curves, quota coverage and programme effectiveness

Lead and grow the team

- Manage, coach and develop a small team of compensation analysts, and set the standard and what good looks like

- Prioritise the team's work, capacity and quarterly OKRs to ensure a balance of reactiveness and impactful projects

- Stay hands-on. This is a doing and leading role, not a management-only role

What you'll bring

Required experience

- 6+ years in sales compensation, revenue operations, sales finance or a closely related field, with experience managing or formally mentoring analysts

- 2-3 years direct management experience

- Proven ownership of a full incentive compensation cycle for a distributed GTM team, including crediting, calculation, payout and dispute resolution

- Hands-on administration of an ICM platform, ideally CaptivateIQ, including building and testing plan logic yourself

- Demonstrated plan design experience: pay mix, leverage, accelerators and quota setting, with the modelling to back the recommendation

- Strong Salesforce data fluency, and the ability to translate commercial requirements into system and crediting logic

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modelling, including capacity, attainment and cost of sale models

- Excellent stakeholder management, with the credibility to hold a position with Sales leaders and the judgement to know when to flex

- You can communicate simply, clearly, and directly, especially with senior leaders, and your written work is polished enough to go straight to an executive audience

Bonus points

- Experience with consumption, usage-based or hybrid pricing models and their compensation implications

- Experience through a CPQ or quote-to-cash migration, ideally Salesforce CPQ or Dealhub

- Experience in cybersecurity, IT or AI markets

- Familiarity with ASC 606 commission capitalisation and audit requirements

- Experience compensating post-sales and partner roles, not just AEs
